India Post GDS Recruitment 2026 FAQs

Q1. What is India Post GDS Recruitment 2026?
India Post GDS Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive for Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS), BPM and ABPM posts in various postal circles across India.

Q2. How many vacancies are available in India Post GDS Recruitment 2026?
More than 25,000 vacancies are expected to be announced. The exact state-wise and category-wise vacancies will be confirmed in the official notification.

Q3. What is the educational qualification for India Post GDS Recruitment 2026?
Candidates must have passed Class 10th from a recognized board. Mathematics and English should be among the required subjects, as prescribed in the official notification.

Q4. Is there any written exam for India Post GDS Recruitment 2026?
No. GDS selection is generally based on a merit list prepared using Class 10 marks, followed by document verification and other required formalities.

Q5. What is the age limit for India Post GDS Recruitment 2026?
The minimum age is 18 years, while the maximum age for the general category is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable to eligible reserved categories as per government rules.

Q6. What is the application fee for India Post GDS Recruitment 2026?
The application fee is expected to be ₹100 for eligible General/OBC/EWS candidates. SC, ST, PwD and female candidates are generally exempted from the application fee, subject to the official notification.

Q7. What is the salary of India Post GDS employees?
The salary depends on the post and working hours. BPM and ABPM/Dak Sevak posts are paid according to the applicable TRCA (Time Related Continuity Allowance) slabs along with admissible allowances.

Q8. Can 10th-pass candidates apply for India Post GDS Recruitment 2026?
Yes. Candidates who have passed 10th class and fulfill all other eligibility conditions can apply for GDS posts.

Q9. Is computer knowledge required for GDS recruitment?
Yes. Candidates are required to have basic computer knowledge as prescribed by India Post. The exact requirements should be checked in the official notification.

Q10. Is knowledge of the local language required for GDS posts?
Yes. Candidates generally need to have knowledge of the local language of the concerned postal circle. The specific language requirements are mentioned in the official notification.
